args: d="$SPEC_DIR"; if [ -z "$d" ]; then c=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) && d=$(dirname "$c")/../show-menu-spec || d=$PWD/../show-menu-spec; fi; if [ ! -f "$d/scripts/spec_mcp_server.py" ]; then printf 'Spec MCP unavailable at %s; set SPEC_DIR to the spec checkout.\n' "$d" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec python3 "$d/scripts/spec_mcp_server.py"
